Tara (Finance): Quick sync — pricing matrix v2 goes live tomorrow 09:00 PT. Final checklist?
Miguel (Billing Ops): I have a couple of billing questions: how are we handling grandfathering for legacy annual customers? pro-rate or keep old price until renewal?
Ken (Revenue Ops): Agreed we should grandfather until renewal. Otherwise we create a lot of invoice adjustments and upset customers.
Priya (Legal): +1 to grandfather until renewal from a contract standpoint. Need a short FAQ note for sales if customers ask.
Ava (Product): For A/B, group A gets new price tiers, group B keeps current for 90 days then migrates on next renewal. We need to ensure usage metrics map cleanly for reporting.
Tara (Finance): OK so policy: existing paid customers = grandfather until renewal; active trial users = default to new pricing (unless manually opted out). Documenting now.
Miguel (Billing Ops): Implementation notes: I'll run a migration script to tag accounts with `pricing_version: legacy` or `pricing_version: v2`. For renewals we'll pick pricing_version at invoice time.
Miguel (Billing Ops): Migration job name: `billing_migrate_pricing_tags_v2` will run midnight UTC. It will set tag, generate audit rows. Need approval to run it tomorrow 02:00 PT.
Tara (Finance): Approved. Please make sure the migration is idempotent and has a dry-run mode.
Miguel (Billing Ops): Will do. Dry-run command: 
```
./scripts/billing_migrate_pricing_tags_v2 --dry-run --since=2024-01-01 --output=sample.csv
```
Tara (Finance): Perfect. Can you attach a sample CSV of affected accounts so RevOps can spot-check?
Miguel (Billing Ops): Sample attached (first 5 rows):
```
account_id,old_plan,active_since,proposed_tag
acct_00123,pro,2022-06-10,legacy
acct_00456,enterprise,2023-11-02,v2
acct_00789,pro,2024-02-14,v2
```
Ken (Revenue Ops): I'll review those 5 and run a small QA set. Flagging: enterprise accounts with negotiated discounts might need manual handling.
Priya (Legal): If any negotiated discount clauses reference specific pricing tiers, escalate to me. We should avoid automated overrides for those.
Ava (Product): Also important: A/B experiment buckets. We need to ensure the routing layer serves the correct price for API calls — otherwise frontend will show wrong totals. Miguel: can the migration add a header or metadata field to be used by billing runtime?
Miguel (Billing Ops): Yes, we'll add `pricing_tag` in customer metadata and expose it as `X-Customer-Pricing-Tag` in internal responses.
Tara (Finance): Billing invoices: for customers switching mid-cycle (non-grandfathered), do we pro-rate token charges or bill at next cycle? We want to avoid double-billing bugs.
Ken (Revenue Ops): For new customers post-go-live, bill by usage with new rates immediately. For migrating customers on renewal, apply new SKU at renewal date; do NOT retroactively adjust usage charges.
Miguel (Billing Ops): Noted. I'll add a reconciliation step to compare token-unit tallies between old and new rates for first 7 days to monitor for divergence.
Tara (Finance): Good. Add an automatic alert if expected revenue delta > 5% in 24h.
Miguel (Billing Ops): I'll wire up a metric: `billing.revenue_delta_p24h` and a PagerDuty rule to the billing ops rotation if threshold exceeded.
billing-bot: scheduled job `invoice-run` completed for 1764507840, 12 invoices failed (retry queued).
Miguel (Billing Ops): I'll investigate the 12 failed invoices — probably due to expired cards for a couple enterprise accounts.
Ava (Product): One more: update public pricing sheet on /pricing and include a clear note about grandfathering rules + experiment A/B description. Marketing wants final copy by EOD.
Tara (Finance): I'll produce the final pricing table and bullets. Ken/Priya please review the FAQ line items: 1) Who is grandfathered, 2) How long, 3) How to opt-out.
Ken (Revenue Ops): Will review by 16:00 PT.
Priya (Legal): I'll do a quick legal spot-check for contractual language by 17:00 PT.
Miguel (Billing Ops): Deployment plan:
- 02:00 PT: dry-run migration (no writes)
- 03:30 PT: run migration (writes + audit rows)
- 04:00 PT: enable new pricing routing for 10% of requests (canary)
- 06:00 PT: increase to 50%
- 08:00 PT: full traffic
Tara (Finance): Good plan. Add rollback steps if reconciliation alerts trip.
Miguel (Billing Ops): Rollback: switch routing back to `pricing_tag` default to `legacy` and run `billing_reconcile_rollback --since=...`
Ava (Product): Product monitor checklist: cart totals check, subscriptions create/update, invoices preview on staging. I'll run end-to-end for 3 customer types.
Tara (Finance): Anything else?
Ken (Revenue Ops): Please add a short note for sales on how to request manual migration for an enterprise account (support ticket + PO).
Priya (Legal): Also log any customer requests to opt into legacy pricing past renewal — we should keep audit trail.
Tara (Finance): Great. If no objections, we'll proceed with the timeline. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Miguel (Billing Ops): Thanks — I'll post results of the dry-run in this thread and attach the sample CSV after the run.
billing-bot: migration dry-run scheduled at 1764542400
